bound: the reach test is a NAME test over one source's literals, so it shows a face the writer could be writing, never that it writes it; a writer whose destination a caller supplies names no face at all, so its reach is under-counted, not over-counted; 'keyed' is the union of resolved sinks over the same corpus E350 walks, so a face keyed only by another unnameable writer still counts as unkeyed; the E350 face is read as published and not rebuilt here
